record: Sydney Harbour Federation Trust site history
facts: The standing replacement was completed in 1883, designed by James Barnet and is 26 metres tall.

record: Macquarie Lightstation Commonwealth Heritage Management Plan
facts: The external tower base is 23.5 feet square and reaches 17 feet before the tower becomes circular. Bluestone gallery, leaded wing domes and 3.7 metre diagonal-glazed Chance lantern remain.
